revision.description: sha256 hex of the canonical JSON of this object without `revision`

policies.description: Only keys the configuration manages are present. true = allowed/enabled.

kiosk.description: Present => ensure kiosk with this KioskApplyPayload. Absent = the configuration does not assert kiosk; the agent exits only if the previously applied configuration document had kiosk.

mobileData.description: Mobile data per app. Absent = not managed (the agent lifts what an earlier document set). The agent itself is never restricted. Limits are bytes per period; over an app limit that app loses mobile data until the next period, over the device limit every user-facing app but `essential` does.

mode.description: blocklist: `apps` may not use mobile data; allowlist: only `apps` may

mechanism.description: absent = auto: setMeteredDataDisabledPackages on Android 9+, the agent's local VPN before

hardware.description: Hardware and ports. Absent = not managed (the agent undoes what an earlier document set). Agents before this section ignore it; the camera is also sent as policies.camera for them.

rules.description: Rule key -> allow | block. Keys: camera, usbDebug, usbData, physicalMedia, bluetoothSharing, bluetoothConfig, nfc, nfcBeam, microphone, airplaneMode, wifiDirect, printing, networkReset, dateTime, unknownSources, locationConfig, locationSharing, contentCapture, assistContent (see registry.md).

restrictions.description: Extra UserManager.DISALLOW_* values from the validated list.
